subject: Trigger prepareCommand on argc change in module command filters (#2945)
reason: The change only executes inside moduleCallCommandFilters (src/module.c:11242), which does nothing unless a module has registered a command filter; it re-runs prepareCommand (recomputing arity and the cluster slot) when a filter changes argc, not just when it changes the command name. The only Valkey test module that registers a command filter is commandfilter.so, whose ValkeyModule_OnLoad returns VALKEYMODULE_ERR unless it is loaded with 2-3 arguments (a log-key name and a noself flag), so it fails to load and aborts server startup when loaded with no arguments.
